notes: Aphex Acid Lead XFX - XFX MODE acid-style leads (resonant filters, short envelopes, a little repeat) across the keyboard, plus 8 XFX CLIP sequences on Bank 1 of the Clip launcher: wandering 16th-note lines with big leaps and octave jumps at 160 BPM. Triggering clips plays whichever per-key voice each note lands on.
